chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on compressing full CoT traces into compact special tokens using contrastive training to ensure semantic alignment with the original reasoning process.
The method relies on inserting special token representations into the input to steer the model's reasoning, effectively replacing explicit text-based CoT with latent token-level representations.
The primary goal of the proposed compression is to achieve efficient decoding and speedups by reducing the length of the reasoning sequence, which aligns with dynamic trajectory compression.
